name: Dunstan
description: Dunstan checks a coding agent's completion report against the pull request's own record (PR state, changed-file paths, commit ids, check runs, linked issues, deployments, a named test-report artifact) and returns a signed record you can re-run locally for the same verdict. Read-only, and optional: the local CLI and Action need no Barg Labs service. Contents: read is in the permission list because GitHub requires it for the commit and compare APIs; Dunstan uses it only to check that a cited commit exists and is reachable from the head. It never requests file contents: a code-level allowlist refuses every blob, tree, contents, archive, tarball, zipball and raw-content route before the request is made. Records are kept 90 days by default (0 to store nothing); report text is never stored. Controller: Barg Labs Ltd. See docs/hosted.md.
